title: Menu and form language lookup hides Reddit failures
current: resolveCurrentSubredditLanguage falls back to the default language whenever getCurrentSubreddit throws, and logs nothing.
evidence: The fallback itself is safe and intended, but the swallowed error is often the first sign that the Reddit API or app permissions are failing for a moderator action.
required: Keep the fallback; add an info or warn diagnostic with the error so the failure is visible.

criticality.why: Diagnostics only: the user still gets a working menu in the default language.
